_comment: Primary Uccle model for TXm: monthly mean daily maximum temperature.
All scientific, computational, figure, and output settings are editable here.

data._comment: null data_dir uses the complete TXm series shipped with bucex.

_comment: The observation model is Gaussian because TXm is a monthly mean.
SSVS selects fixed/dynamic level, absent/fixed/dynamic slope, and fixed/dynamic seasonality.
The structural priors match the calibrated primary extreme-temperature analysis.
trend_probabilities and season_probabilities are ordered [zero, fixed, dynamic].
sigma2 is the Gaussian observation-variance prior in the IG(a,b) convention.

mcmc._comment: draws are retained draws per chain after warmup.

inference._comment: Gaussian FFBS is exact; there are no particles or Laplace proposal settings.

figures._comment: Tables are always written. Titles are off unless supplied below.

runtime._comment: The chain runner manages chain_only and combine_runs; normal users leave them unchanged.

output._comment: Leave run_id null for a collision-safe automatic directory.
